Video.js 8.16.1
================

Source: https://github.com/videojs/video.js/releases/tag/v8.16.1
License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE and vtt/LICENSE).

The distributed files are the browser assets selected for this plugin:
video.min.js, video-js.min.css and vtt/vtt.min.js. To update to another
release, change the version and URL in this file and the version in
thirdpartylibs.xml,
download that exact release archive, compare the three selected files
byte-for-byte with the archive, and replace only those three files at their
existing paths. Keep both license files, then run the plugin JavaScript tests.
No local build step is required for the checked-in assets.
